<translate>
<!--T:5-->
'''Kame House''' (Roshi's House) is [[Special:MyLanguage/Master Roshi|Master Roshi]]'s home on the coast of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], which he shares with [[Special:MyLanguage/Krillin|Krillin]]. Roshi teaches the basics and gives out weighted Turtle Shells, and the early [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] sends you here to meet him.
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here == <!--T:6-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:7-->
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Master Roshi|Master Roshi]]''' teaches the basics (Jump, Meditation, Ki Control, the Kamehameha and [[Special:MyLanguage/Afterimage|Afterimage]]) and gives you a weighted '''Turtle Shell'''. He needs Good alignment (61 or higher).
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Krillin|Krillin]]''' teaches ki skills and techniques and runs the [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]] [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames|training minigame]]. He also needs Good alignment.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it == <!--T:8-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:9-->
Kame House generates once per world, on the coast of an ocean. [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistants]] can sell a '''Kame House Map''' at trade tier 1, for 8 Cod and an empty Map. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate roshi_house}}. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Finding structures|Finding structures]].
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:10-->
Like every master's home, the house can't be damaged by ki attacks (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Protection|Protection]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:11-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:12-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quest 6, ''The Turtle Hermit'': find Kame House and talk to Master Roshi.
* Classic Saga quest 7, ''Milk Delivery Training'': give Master Roshi 3 Milk Buckets.
* Classic Saga quest 30, ''Heavy Shell Training'': give Master Roshi 1 Scute.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] quest 13, ''Recovering at Kame House'': give Krillin 12 [[Special:MyLanguage/Golden Carrot|Golden Carrots]].
</translate>
